Sinayoko steals the show!
Paris FC secured an impressive 3-1 victory over AS Monaco in Ligue 1, with Lassine Sinayoko netting a first-half brace in the 38th and 44th minutes. Folarin Balogun pulled one back for Monaco in the 65th minute, before Pablo Pagis sealed the win for Paris FC in the 74th.
Watch the key moments from Paris FC’s impressive win at the Stade Jean-Bouin as they claim all three points!
